LanguageData.HH.Inn.Door.Preview: {0} of people from friendly factions would be welcome.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Gender: Half the world uninvited. Efficient, you sexist.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Tech: Too primitive for your fine dining? Noted.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Title: Class warfare, but make it hospitality.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Wealth: Only the rich. Your landlord would be proud.

LanguageData.HH.Inn.GuestBed.Desc: Rent this bed to guests. Colonists will not sleep here; guests only sleep in guest beds. The price per night follows the room, the bed and how many beds share the room.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.GuestBed.Inactive: Guest bed (inactive while medical, prisoner or slave bed)
LanguageData.HH.Inn.GuestBed.Label: Guest bed
LanguageData.HH.Inn.GuestBed.NotColonistBed: Only a normal colonist bed (not medical, prisoner or slave) can be a guest bed.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Handling.AccompanyDesc: Colonists with Hosting work keep this guest company: better mood, better ratings. Costs colonist time. Falls back to basics when nobody can host.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Handling.BasicsDesc: Paid services only, no entertainment. Costs no colonist time.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Handling.Click: Click to switch: Basics → Accompany → Recruit.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Handling.Label: Handling: {0}
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Handling.RecruitDesc: Like Accompany, plus talks about staying. If the colony's bond with the guest is strong enough, they may join at departure. Pushy talks can offend.

LanguageData.HH.Inn.Msg.LeavingTemperature: Your guests from {0} are leaving: it is dangerously hot or cold.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Msg.LeavingWounded: Your guests from {0} are taking their wounded home.

LanguageData.HH.Inn.Msg.WingGrown: {0} now reaches {1}: guests can walk there.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.PriceMode.GizmoDesc: Change the price of this bed: free (for friends and recruits), 25 % off, the automatic price, or 25 % more. Applies to the next booking.

LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.Broke: Almost out of money: will leave early.

LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.Cold: Too cold ({0}): heat the guest wing.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.ColdMany: {0} guests are too cold: heat the guest wing.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.Hot: Too hot ({0}): cool the guest wing with coolers.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.HotMany: {0} guests are too hot: cool the guest wing with coolers.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.Hungry: Hungry: stock a restaurant or tavern with meals (open, staffed).
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.HungryMany: {0} guests are hungry: stock a restaurant or tavern with meals.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.Insulted: Felt pestered by recruiting: switch the handling to Accompany.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.InsultedMany: {0} guests felt pestered: recruit less pushily.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.MoodMany: {0} guests are in a bad mood (see their Guest tab).

LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.PriceyMany: {0} guests find their rooms too expensive: lower bed prices or improve the rooms.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.Waited: Waited in vain for service: give your venues staff (Serving work).
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Problem.WaitedMany: {0} guests waited in vain: give your venues staff (Serving work).
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Recruit.Insulted: felt pestered: will not join this time
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Recruit.TooImportant: too important at home to join
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Hostile: They left as enemies. No tip.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Label: Guests left: {0}
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.LeftBroke: Their money ran out before their stay did.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.LeftEarly: They left before their planned day.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.0: The guests from {FACTION} left with a list. It was not a shopping list.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.1: {NAME} promised to tell everyone about the {ROOM}. That is the problem.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.2: A stay to forget, if {FACTION} lets anyone forget it.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.0: The guests from {FACTION} left. It happened, and that is about all.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.1: A stay of the kind nobody writes home about. {NAME} wrote home anyway.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.2: {NAME} rated the {ROOM} "a room". Hard to argue.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.0: The guests from {FACTION} left content and only slightly lighter in the purse.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.1: A pleasant stay. Nobody complained loudly enough to count.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.2: {NAME} called the {ROOM} "honest", which from {FACTION} is a compliment.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.0: The guests from {FACTION} left glowing. One of them hugged the doorframe.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.1: {FACTION} will be talking about this stay for a while, mostly in a good way.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.2: A flawless stay. {NAME} asked whether the {ROOM} could be booked again "for life".
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.0: The guests from {FACTION} left early in spirit and on time in body.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.1: {NAME} described the {ROOM} with a word our clerk refused to write down.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.2: Not a disaster. Not a stay you would put on a sign, either.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.SentAway: You asked them to leave. They did, with the expression people use for that.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Report.Temperature: The weather sent them home early.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.SendAway.Desc: Ask this guest's whole group to leave now. Nights already paid are kept, no goodwill is gained, renown −1.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.SendAway.Label: Send away
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Tab.Inactive: Nobody is coming: mark a bed as guest bed or open a venue.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Tab.Summary: Renown {0} · Whispers {1} · {2} groups hosted · {3} guest beds ({4} free)
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Verdict.0: Slept badly and blamed the room.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Verdict.1: Found the room below their standard.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Wing.ClearDesc: Remove cells from the guest wing.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Wing.ExpandDesc: Paint where guests may go. Guests stay inside their wing (the bed's room is always allowed). Without any wing, guests wander near their rooms.
LanguageData.HH.Inn.Wing.Name: Guest Wing {0}
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.arrivalNotice.Desc: A short letter for your first groups, a quiet message afterwards.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.arrivalRate.Desc: Multiplier on how often guest groups arrive. 1 = the normal rhythm of your difficulty; 0 stops new arrivals.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.autoWing.Desc: The first guest bed creates Guest Wing 1 around its room; later guest rooms join the nearest wing.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.cardThreshold.Desc: Guests from industrial or more advanced factions with a budget above this pay by card instead of carrying silver.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.checkInHour.Desc: Overnight guests plan to arrive from this hour on.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.checkOutHour.Desc: Overnight guests leave around this hour on their last morning.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.dayVisitors.Desc: Groups that only come for your open venues during opening hours and leave before closing time. Needs at least one venue sign.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.deskCloseHour.Desc: From this hour the front desk is an honesty box: guests check themselves in and pay a little less.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.deskOpenHour.Desc: From this hour a host can check guests in at the front desk. Outside the hours the desk works as an honesty box.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.expectationOffset.Desc: Added to every guest's expectation (0 … 1). Higher means harder to please.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.firstGuestMaxDays.Desc: Days after your first guest bed (or venue) by which the very first group will have arrived.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.firstGuestMinDays.Desc: Days after your first guest bed (or venue) until the very first group can arrive.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.forecastDays.Desc: How far ahead the arrival plan is drawn up (shown in the guest overview).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillCapQuadrum.Desc: Hosting can raise a faction's goodwill by at most this much per quadrum.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillCeiling.Desc: Hosting alone never lifts a faction above this goodwill (75 = ally threshold).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillLossCap: Largest goodwill loss per bad stay
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillLossCap.Desc: A bad stay costs a faction at most this much goodwill.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.guestMoney.Desc: Multiplier on how much silver guests bring.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.honestyDiscount.Desc: Guests who check in at the unattended front desk (outside its hours) pay this much less per night.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.insultBase.Desc: Base chance that a recruitment talk offends the guest (lower with better social skill).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.leaveEarly.Desc: Guests who are miserable for a long time, or run out of money, pack up before their planned day.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.leavingGifts.Desc: Happy guests sometimes leave a small gift at the front desk (more likely the better the stay).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.maxGroupSize.Desc: No group brings more guests than this. Overnight groups are also limited by your free guest beds.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.podDistance.Desc: Guests of industrial or better factions arrive by drop pod when the walk from the map edge would be longer than this many cells.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.priceBase.Desc: Price of an economy bed for one night. Better rooms, beds and private rooms multiply it (shown on every guest bed).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.priceTolerance.Desc: How much over their comfort price guests are still willing to pay.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.renownLossCap.Desc: One unhappy group lowers your renown by at most this much.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.reportMode.Desc: How the short report after each stay reaches you: as a letter, as a quiet message, or not at all.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.returnPinCap.Desc: Guests who plan to come back are kept as world pawns until their visit. Above this many, the oldest planned return visits are dropped.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.returnVisits.Desc: Guests who liked their stay come back after 3 to 10 days (unhappy ones after 14 to 30), plus twice their travel time.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.stayNightsMax.Desc: Overnight guests stay at most this many nights.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.stayNightsMin.Desc: Overnight guests stay at least this many nights.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.inn.waitThoughts.Desc: Guests who wait in vain or ring the night bell with nobody coming feel it in their mood; a waiting room softens it.
